cases.note: fx-dosfull: every game asks for full screen by itself at its first graphics mode. On the T23 and other displays that accept it, the game runs full screen and the user's Alt+Enter returns it to the window (remembered); QEMU's standard VGA refuses it (f3-29, known failure), and the game continues in its window with one record. The later Alt+Enter cycle is the user's own switch; its QEMU refusal is the same known failure; any other refusal or a missing request fails the game.

cases.title: User accounts: the first boot logs on to the CiukiUser desktop automatically; User Accounts creates a Standard user; Log Off, then log on as that user, who cannot install into C:\Programs but can into C:\GAME and cannot write HKLM, read another profile or save machine settings; Guest; the password-protected screen saver locks; Ctrl+Alt+Del reaches the trusted screen; Restart and Shut Down from the logon screen

steps.name: b1-win32-window
steps.wait: ^\[user \d+\] \[desktop\] focus pid=<<boot_win32>> window=\d+ titled=1 internal=0 app=\S+$

steps.name: b1-win32-closed
steps.wait: ^\[user \d+\] \[desktop\] focus pid=0 window=0 titled=0 internal=-1 app=desktop$

steps.name: cp1-run
steps.note: Win+R opens Run

steps.name: cp1-window
wait: ^\[user \d+\] \[desktop\] focus pid=<<cp1>> window=\d+ titled=\d internal=0 app=control$

steps.name: cp1-pw
steps.note: User Accounts: Change the password (current, new, confirm)

steps.name: cp1-pw-done
steps.wait: ^\[user \d+\] \[accounts\] manage op=password caller=1000 target=1000 type=admin result=0$
steps.fail: ^\[user \d+\] \[accounts\] manage op=password caller=\d+ target=\d+ type=\w+ result=-\d+$

steps.name: newbob
steps.note: User Accounts: Create a new account Bob (standard user)

steps.name: newbob-done
steps.wait: ^\[user \d+\] \[accounts\] manage op=create caller=1000 target=(?P<newbob_uid>\d+) type=standard result=0$
steps.fail: ^\[user \d+\] \[accounts\] manage op=create caller=\d+ target=\d+ type=\w+ result=-\d+$

steps.name: cp1-close
steps.note: Alt+F4 closes the Control Panel

steps.name: lo1
steps.note: Start > Log Off

steps.name: stbob-run
steps.note: Win+R opens Run

steps.name: stbob-done
wait: ^\[console\] sectest begin version=1 uid=<<newbob_uid>> gid=\d+ session=\d+ groups=545 role=standard expect=standard profile=\S+ result=0 verdict=pass$
^\[console\] sectest end role=standard checks=\d+ passed=\d+ failed=0 skipped=\d+$
steps.note: sectest --expect=standard --keep: one record per check (apps/systools/sectest_model.c)

steps.name: saver-run
steps.note: Win+R opens Run

steps.name: saver-start
steps.note: a key dismisses the saver

steps.name: saver-locked
wait: ^\[user \d+\] \[logon\] session <<bob_session>> locked by the screen saver$
^\[user \d+\] \[logon-ui\] view mode=locked view=password items=\d+ accounts=\d+ status=\w+$

steps.name: saver-refused
wait: ^\[user \d+\] \[logon-ui\] view mode=locked view=password items=\d+ accounts=\d+ status=incorrect$

steps.name: cad
steps.note: Ctrl+Alt+Del

steps.name: cad-menu
wait: ^\[user \d+\] \[logon-ui\] view mode=security view=menu items=5 accounts=\d+ status=\w+$
steps.note: Esc: Cancel

steps.name: lo2
steps.note: Start > Log Off

steps.name: cp2-run
steps.note: Win+R opens Run

steps.name: cp2-window
wait: ^\[user \d+\] \[desktop\] focus pid=<<cp2>> window=\d+ titled=\d internal=0 app=control$

steps.name: guest-select
steps.note: the list cursor starts at item 0 (CiukiAdministrator); Down selects Guest

steps.name: guest-pw
steps.note: User Accounts: Reset the password

steps.name: guest-pw-done
steps.wait: ^\[user \d+\] \[accounts\] manage op=password caller=1000 target=501 type=guest result=0$
steps.fail: ^\[user \d+\] \[accounts\] manage op=password caller=\d+ target=\d+ type=\w+ result=-\d+$

steps.name: guest-on
steps.note: User Accounts: Turn on the account

steps.name: guest-on-done
